sketches.mechanism: An interface with a method that returns itself but is never implemented — the abstract method declaration without a body means the promise is declared but permanently unfulfilled.
sketches.resonance: A promise that can only be declared, never kept — the interface guarantees a shape of devotion that no class ever fills.

sketches.mechanism: A sealed trait with no extending cases makes pattern matching impossible — the compiler knows there are no inhabitants of the type, so you can never construct or match on it.
sketches.resonance: You can name what you've lost, give it a type, but no instance of it can ever exist again.

sketches.mechanism: A receive block with no matching clause and an `after 0` timeout — the process waits for a message that matches, finds nothing in the mailbox, and immediately times out.
sketches.resonance: The moment of listening for something that was never sent — the mailbox is checked, found empty, and the waiting ends before it begins.
sketches.draft:
defmodule Vigil do
  def wait do
    receive do
      {:return} -> wait()
    after
      0 -> :silence
    end
  end
end
